criteria.execution: one subject.exe path; two binary blocks per round; label order alternates; case order rotates by one
criteria.round_indices: warmup=-1, formal=0..5; odd rounds candidate first, even rounds t28 first
criteria.ties: equal elapsed times count as neither a win nor a slower round
criteria.pairing: same case and formal round; elapsed wall milliseconds, warmup excluded
criteria.other_segments: array_map_filter and array_sort_reduce are diagnostic only, with all medians and paired counts reported
criteria.correctness: every process exit 0, no stderr, stdout exact after CRLF normalization; any mismatch or timeout aborts screen
criteria.selection: pass iff both improvement criteria hold, neither veto holds and every output matches; not the R304 release gate
criteria.retries: no automatic retry, early performance stop, sample removal or threshold change
